def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    for color in range(1, 10):

        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1 - r0 < 2 or c1 - c0 < 2:
            continue
        perimeter = {(r, c) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)
                     if r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)}
        if all(grid[r][c] == color for r, c in perimeter):
            frames.append((color, r0, r1, c0, c1, perimeter))
            frame_cells.update(perimeter)

    output = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for color, r0, r1, c0, c1, perimeter in frames:
        for r, c in perimeter:
            output[r][c] = color

    # Isolated marks encode the fill colors. Pair each frame with the color
    # whose mark count is closest to the checkerboard population of its cavity.
    marks = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                    if grid[r][c] != 0 and (r, c) not in frame_cells)
    candidates = [(color, n) for color, n in marks.items() if color not in {f[0] for f in frames}]
    used = set()
    for frame_color, r0, r1, c0, c1, perimeter in sorted(frames, key=lambda f: (f[1], f[3])):

        available = [(abs(n - target), color) for color, n in candidates if color not in used]

        _, fill_color = min(available)
        used.add(fill_color)
        for r, c in interior:
